message.modserver.terrain_map_unavailabl: Install JourneyMap on this client to view the terrain map.
screen.modserver.nation_map.controls: Wheel: zoom | Drag: pan | Right-click: inspect or dispute | Esc: close
modserver.map.dimension: Travel to the selected dimension to inspect this chunk.
modserver.map.active: Dispute in progress. %s is attacking, %s is defending.
modserver.map.free: This chunk is unclaimed. You can dispute land that belongs to another nation.
modserver.map.found: Found a nation with /nation create <name> to dispute territory.
modserver.map.own: This territory belongs to your nation.
modserver.map.agreement: Your agreement with %s prevents a dispute.
modserver.map.wait: You can dispute this chunk in %s s.
modserver.map.funds: The dispute costs %s coins. Your treasury holds %s.
modserver.map.offer: On confirmation, %s will pay %s coins. %s will have %s min to defend the chunk.
modserver.map.heading: [nation] Territory map · North ↑ · Chunk %s, %s
modserver.map.legend: □ Unclaimed  ▣ Border  ▧ Disputed · Your chunk is underlined · Click to inspect
modserver.npc.found: First, found a nation with /nation create <name>.
modserver.npc.rules: The attacker takes the chunk when time runs out unless it was defended. A protected garrison can spend one point to keep it.
modserver.npc.defense: Use /nation defend X Z in the same dimension before time runs out. If you owe defense costs, use /nation defense pay first.
modserver.npc.receive: Accept an attack by %s on my nation
modserver.npc.actions: Each option opens a dispute over the indicated chunk.
modserver.npc.approach: Move closer to the envoy to accept the challenge.
modserver.npc.changed: This territory no longer belongs to %s. Speak to the envoy again.
modserver.npc.keep: Use /nation defend %s %s to keep the chunk.
modserver.npc.win: If time runs out without a defense, %s takes the territory.
modserver.war.idle: At war with %s · No active disputes
modserver.war.disputed: %1$s disputes your territory. Defend it with /nation defend %2$s %3$s.
modserver.war.invasion: %1$s attacks your chunk %2$s, %3$s. Defend it with /nation defend %2$s %3$s.
modserver.war.cancelled: The dispute over chunk %s was cancelled
